title: Identity Pathway: Compact Roles Editor + Audit Coalesce Prototype
creator: Marina Alvarez
description: Problem: Operators and admins need a compact, single-pane console entrypoint to quickly understand who has access, recent audit events, and the cost/latency implications of permission rollouts. Current console flows force users to jump between Roles, Workspace Settings, and Audit Log, which is slow during incident response and access reviews.
goals: Design a compact Roles Editor that surfaces role memberships, temporal grants, and suggested least-privilege edits inline
Provide an 'Audit Coalesce' timeline that groups related permission events (grant->escalation->revoke) into a single expandable story
Tie recent rollouts and permission changes to cost signals (est. token/endpoint cost) and to any active canary/deployment policies
Prototype keyboard-first workflows for on-call engineers to perform quick access revocation and 'impersonate-as' checks without losing context
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype of Compact Roles Editor + Audit Coalesce flow with responsive states for 1024px and 1440px
Validated microcopy for temporal grants, justification fields, and audit story headers reviewed by legal/compliance
Usability test (5 participants) shows <30s median time to revoke access for a user in the same workspace
Design tokens and spacing spec created and handed to ENG; a mocked API contract (fields required) linked in artifacts
updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff with PM (Anika Rao) and Eng (Ravi Patel) to align scope. Agreed MVP excludes cross-workspace revoke for this cycle.
2026-03-02: Initial low-fi sketches completed. Chose a compact card pattern (left: identity, middle: role badges, right: actions + cost delta).
2026-03-05: First Figma pass created (file linked in artifacts). Design review with Security flagged verbatim justification text for removal — updated copy.
2026-03-08: Implemented Audit Coalesce grouping rules: window=15m, same-resource, same-executor. PM requested adding an option to expand raw events.
2026-03-10: Design peer review completed. Sending to UX research for 5 remote unmoderated tests (script in artifacts). Preparing handoff notes for ENG.
Next: Finalize accessibility labels, prepare a small animation spec for coalesce expand/collapse, and schedule rollout A/B with PM.
ux_research: Planned tests: 5 engineers and 3 security admins; success task: 'Revoke access for user@example.com for project:analytics'
Metrics: time-to-complete, error-rate, subjective confidence (1-7), and observed context-loss moments
Recruitment note: prioritize participants who used console during incidents in past 6 months
design_notes: Use condensed tokenized role chips with hover reveal for permissions (avoid long permission lists inline)
Audit Coalesce should include a top-line reason snippet pulled from justification metadata when available
Cost deltas will be a soft yellow badge showing estimated monthly cost impact; full estimate lives in a slide-over
Keyboard shortcuts: 'r' to open revoke modal on focused card, 'i' to impersonate preview
Accessibility: ensure coalesce expand/collapse is reachable via aria-controls and uses live regions for updates
